+---
+'@ogygia/core': patch
+---
+
+A hole whose `prefetch` warm still waits for a background turn fetches at once when it wakes on screen, the visitor reaches for it, or `preload()` asks for it, instead of waiting behind the page's other prefetches.

+---

new file .changeset/live-tick-store-newest.md
+---
+'@ogygia/core': patch
+---
+
+A static live region no longer paints a tick over a newer update of the same region (a command that returned it) that landed while the tick was on its way, nor a tick whose data version is older than the one on screen.

new file .changeset/location-map-order.md
+---
+'@ogygia/core': patch
+---
+
+Two builds of the same code write the same `og-locations` map under the same name, so a deploy with no island change no longer busts its cache.

new file .changeset/machine-queue.md
+---
+'@ogygia/machine': minor
+---
+
+New `queue()`: a bounded, first-come queue. At most `max` jobs hold a place; a `release()` hands its place to the next job in the same step. A job can carry a deadline (all deadlines share one timer) or be cancelled, and the queue's `owner` closing makes the waiting jobs stale.

new file .changeset/one-hash.md
+---
+'@ogygia/core': patch
+---
+
+`import.meta.og.bake` addresses each evaluated bundle by a 64-bit hash of its inputs (was 32-bit), so two modules can no longer share a cached bake by collision.

new file .changeset/router-prefetch-priority.md
+---
+'@ogygia/core': patch
+---
+
+A click on a link whose page prefetch still waits for its turn sends that request at high priority, the visitor's, instead of the prefetch's low one.

new file .changeset/trigger-union.md
+---
+'@ogygia/core': patch
+---
+
+A hole fetched on `interaction` and kept as a live region revalidates on load after a remount, instead of waiting on a media query named `interaction` that never matches.

+
+Work that waits for room: at most `max` jobs hold a place at once, first come, first served.

+	max: 4,

+	stale: (call) => call.gone() // its deadline came, it was cancelled, or the owner closed

+
+|                       |                                                                                              |
+| --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
+| `max`                 | The most jobs holding a place at once.                                                       |
+| `start(job)`          | Starts a job; its place is its until `release()`.                                            |
+| `stale(job)`          | Hears a job that will never start: its deadline came, it was cancelled, or the owner closed. |
+| `now`                 | The clock deadlines are read on. Default `performance.now()`.                                |
+| `owner`               | Closing it makes every waiting job stale, and any pushed after.                              |
+| `push(job, deadline)` | Queues a job, to start in turn or be stale at its deadline.                                  |
+| `cancel(job)`         | A waiting job leaves at once, stale; a started one is untouched.                             |
+| `release()`           | A started job's work is done: its place goes to the next job, in this step.                  |
